nodes.label: snapshotNow(docId:reason:) — .beforeSuggestion / .beforeVoiceInsert
nodes.rationale: Must be called before applying, so the snapshot holds the «before» state; skipped only if nothing arrived or was edited since the last snapshot.

nodes.label: Voice.timestamp / Voice.speakerLabel / Voice.agentId (voice/timestamps.json)
nodes.rationale: «мм:сс», from one hour «ч:мм:сс»; S2 → «Собеседник 2»; agentId voice marks agentEdit «Голос».

nodes.label: NoteDocument
nodes.rationale: Undo/redo on NoteDocument also re-anchor stroke anchors (strokes.md §4.1).

nodes.label: account_changed and waiting for key or access (D-62)
AttachmentManager
nodes.rationale: Attachment ids are UUIDv7 only everywhere, so ids like ../library.sqlite cannot escape the attachments folder.

nodes.label: Block / Inline / Mark
nodes.rationale: Unknown nodes kept as raw and written back as is.

nodes.label: Canonical notebook key from the server
nodes.rationale: One notebook key for all devices — the one wrapped by master key on server; old key retired, read-only.

nodes.label: CRDTDocument
nodes.rationale: All text offsets are UTF-16, like NSString/NSRange and Yjs.

nodes.label: Failed messages (SyncStatus.failed)
nodes.rationale: doc_not_found and server errors fail after LocalStore.maxSendAttempts (5); rate_limited and connection drops retry without counting.

nodes.label: Resilience to stuck TLS handshakes
nodes.rationale: One URLSession for REST and WebSocket reuses connections.

nodes.label: Heartbeat: pong timeout replaces silently dead connections
Index changes sent before note changes
nodes.rationale: Note key travels in its notebook NoteMeta, so other device does not wait in vain.

nodes.label: KDFParams.validate() — server KDF bounds (CryptoError.unsafeKDF)
nodes.rationale: A hostile server cannot cheapen loginKey for password brute force.

nodes.label: Live documents only for open notes
nodes.rationale: Thousands of notes stay as SQLite updates; snapshots of closed docs by merging updates.

nodes.label: Sign-out keeps keys of unsent notebooks (spec/07)
MarkdownExport / canonical PM JSON
nodes.rationale: Obsidian-style Markdown byte-for-byte equal to TS.

nodes.label: Notebook key rotation steps 1–3 (pendingSinceVersion)
nodes.rationale: Whether step 1 is done is decided by pendingSinceVersion, so any owner device can finish it.

nodes.label: Notebook meta copy for agents
nodes.rationale: Agents do not read the account document, so name/icon/colour/space are copied into notebook meta.

nodes.label: Orphaned strokes purged before snapshot (orphanedStrokeIds, purgeOrphanedStrokes)
Parallel attachment transfers (3 chunk requests, progress)
Prebuilt yrs_ffiFFI.xcframework GitHub release
nodes.rationale: Consumers need no Rust or scripts: SwiftPM downloads and verifies checksum; local build/ has priority over release.

nodes.label: PutAdminVoiceRequest (monthlyMinutes: .keep / .reset / .set(n))
nodes.rationale: .keep omits the field, .reset sends null, .set(n) sets a custom quota — three distinct states on the wire.

nodes.label: NoteDocument.restoreVersion(state:) — restore content and strokes with re-anchoring
account.shared SharedRef with openedAt (D-54, D-63)
nodes.rationale: markSharedOpened writes openedAt only once, so «new» is the same on all devices.

nodes.label: Snapshot on leaving a document (snapshotOnLeave(docId:); snapshotOnLeave() on background; close)
nodes.rationale: The app keeps all notes open in the engine, so leaving a note does not stop its sync; close is only for real closing and also snapshots by the rule.

nodes.label: SnapshotPolicy — history versions = snapshots (spec/06)
nodes.rationale: Snapshot on leave if ≥1 edit since this device's last snapshot and ≥2 min passed; while editing 10 min after first edit since snapshot (checked on each edit); before a suggestion or voice insert; plus 500 updates / 1 MiB thresholds. Time comes from SyncEngine clock parameter so tests can move it.

nodes.label: Sync protocol v2 client (hello latest, fallback on protocol_mismatch)
Sync speed: lazy registration, priority subscribe, focus
nodes.rationale: Previously registering 55 docs one by one at RTT 100 ms took 6.3 s.

nodes.label: SyncStatus.waiting (.key / .access)
nodes.rationale: Nothing waits silently.

nodes.label: SyncEngine
nodes.rationale: Each local update stored atomically with outbox (nothing lost until ack); encrypts ds1|doc|<docId>; registers before first push; snapshot after 500 updates / 1 MiB after purging orphaned strokes; ≤100 messages awaiting ack.

nodes.label: TransactionOrigin
nodes.rationale: .local goes to undo and server; .system to server without undo; .undo, .remote, .storage.

nodes.label: AccountDocument.voiceConsentAt (settings.voiceConsentAt)
nodes.rationale: Stored in the account document so consent is asked once for all devices.

nodes.label: Voice API contract types (D-65)
nodes.rationale: Strict parsing against core vectors api/bodies.json and voice/timestamps.json; requests to the server are made by the app (ios-app), not DSCore.

nodes.label: Voice error codes (voice_disabled, voice_quota, voice_too_long, voice_upstream, voice_unavailable)
VoiceTextRequest / VoiceTextResponse (turns or text, style for format, profanity default soften)
nodes.rationale: Exactly one of turns/text; style only for format.

nodes.label: No key yet is not unreadable
Poor network resilience (build 46, 2026-11-11)
nodes.rationale: Owner complaint on build 46 over uneven 4G: queue, reconnects and indicator reworked so that connection drops never lose or block edits.

nodes.label: Connection failure is not a delivery attempt (send error keeps message queued, attempt not counted)
nodes.rationale: Previously five connection drops sent edits to failed forever.

nodes.label: Migration v9-requeue-connection-failures / LocalStore.requeueConnectionFailures()
nodes.rationale: Returns messages wrongly failed by connection drops back to the queue.

nodes.label: Non-blocking queue: flushPass takes only live documents (pendingOutbox(docIds:limit:))
nodes.rationale: A document without a key and hundreds of edits no longer clogs the page.

nodes.label: subscribeQueue: windowed prioritised subscription (≤200 documents catching up at once)
nodes.rationale: Order: account and indexes → open (focus) → documents with unsent edits → prefetch(_:) → the rest, newest first.

nodes.label: SyncEngine.prefetch(_:) — hint for documents changed elsewhere
syncClientDidConnect returns at once; subscription runs alongside frame receiving (connectionGeneration)
nodes.rationale: Otherwise on a slow link frames were not read until the whole subscription went out; the old connection’s work stops by connectionGeneration.

nodes.label: Late pong while frames arrive does not drop the connection (SyncClient lastFrameAt)
After catch-up, sending starts only if the document has something to send
Snapshot over 16 MiB (server limit, was 50) is marked as rejected at once
Sync indicator: SyncActivityGate / SyncEngine.activityUpdates()
nodes.rationale: On after 3 s of waiting work, lit at least 1.5 s, off 1 s after work ends; a reconnect without unsent work does not light it. SyncStatus.oldestPendingAt, catchingUpSince.

nodes.label: SyncEngine.diagnostics() → SyncDiagnostics
nodes.rationale: Connection, connections since launch, last error, pending per document with age, rejects, deferred incoming, waiting for key or access.

nodes.label: SyncResilienceTests (slow link, drops every 250 ms, late pongs, 600-note library)
open no longer re-queues content already in the store (CRDTUpdates.insertsContent)
nodes.rationale: Previously open saved loaded content as a new local edit: every launch queued the full state of every note (565 messages for the owner), and big notes were rejected at once with payload_too_large (local).

nodes.label: Pushes > 32 KiB trimmed to what the server lacks (serverStateVector); dropped if nothing new
Migration v10-requeue-oversized-pushes (second chance for pushes rejected as oversized)
SyncDiagnostics.events — sync event log (last 200: connections, send drops, server errors with document, rejects, trimmed pushes)

hyperedges.label: DSCore D-65 voice contract types (transcribe, text, me, admin, errors, consent)
